description: Configs that the schema accepts but that core's validate() must judge, shared by core's tests (core/tests/semantic_cases_test.cpp, through a table CMake generates from this file) and the editor's (editor/test/semanticCases.test.ts), so the editor's polite checks and core's enforcement cannot drift apart (docs/decisions.md D-040, D-048). Each case is one change to the base config: a polygon for its single room, or a map area. 'valid' false means validate() reports an Error at 'path'; true means no Error at all.

cases.name: three collinear points with inexact coordinates
three collinear points on an axis
first vertex repeated at the end
an edge folding back over the previous one
a thin sliver, one millionth of the map thick, is a real room
map area larger than the canvas
map area running off the canvas's bottom edge
map area exactly filling the canvas
